attributes.action: Ban AI-Generated Images of Food on UK Restaurant Menus and Delivery Platforms
attributes.additional_details:
AI-generated food images can create unrealistic expectations about the appearance, portion sizes, ingredients and quality of meals. Customers should be able to make informed decisions about what they are purchasing, without being misled by digitally created images that may bear little resemblance to the actual food they receive.

We ask the Government and Parliament to:
Introduce regulations preventing restaurants and takeaways from using AI-generated images that misrepresent the food they sell.
attributes.background: We ask the UK Government to introduce legislation requiring restaurants, takeaways and food delivery platforms to use genuine photographs of the food they actually serve, rather than misleading AI-generated images.
